references.text: God commands Moses to go up on Mount Abarim to see the land that will be given to the children of Israel, a parallel command to the one in Deuteronomy 32:49
The Lord speaks to Moses about going up on Mount Abarim, Mount Nebo, the same event described in Deuteronomy 32:49
Moses was allowed to see the land from the top of Pisgah, an earlier reference to seeing the land of Canaan from a mountain
Fulfillment of the command: Moses goes up on Mount Nebo and sees the whole land of Canaan before he dies
God's promise to Abraham to give the land of Canaan to his descendants, the same land mentioned in Deuteronomy 32:49
God promises to give the land of Canaan to Abraham's descendants as an eternal possession, related to the promise of the land that Israel will inherit
Continuation of the text explaining that Moses is only to see the land from a distance but not enter it
